about_the_game:
Enter the world of 1v1 Block Puzzle Battles!

Experience the thrill of real-time matches as you send disruptive attack blocks to your opponent’s board.

The more lines you clear, the stronger your attacks become. Keep your combo going to stack bigger bonuses.

Enjoy the excitement of multi-line clears that deal massive damage in a single move!


🌟 Why you'll love this game:

🔸 Real-time 1v1 online battles: Test your skills against friends or players around the world.

🔹 Attack block strategy: Every time you clear a line, send a random garbage block to your opponent’s field.

🔸 Combo system: Keep clearing lines on consecutive turns without breaking to increase your combo and prepare stronger attacks.

🔹 Multi-line clears: Clear multiple lines at once for a huge attack bonus!

🔸 Offline mode supported: Practice alone or battle AI bots anytime, anywhere.


💥 Key Features:

  • Strategic placement and clearing on an 8x8 puzzle board.

  • Simple rules with deep tactical battles.

  • Invite friends for 1v1 matches using special codes.

  • Automatic matchmaking to battle players worldwide.

  • Fully playable offline without Wi-Fi.


🎮 How to Play:

  • Drag blocks onto the 8x8 grid.

  • Complete full rows or columns to clear them and gain attack points.

  • Send attack blocks to your opponent’s board to claim victory.

  • Keep your combo going or aim for multi-line clears to unleash powerful attacks.

✨ Tips!

  • Use one of your three blocks to maintain your combo without breaking it!

  • Use the other two blocks to prepare even stronger attacks!

🔥 Download now and experience the ultimate 1v1 block puzzle battle of strategy and speed!
